description: Cross-runtime parity authority for the Distractor Derivation Model. Every expected outcome is generated through the Go reference derive() / stmtGateApply() and serialized with the canonical encoder; replayed byte-for-byte by the Go reference (task 8.2), the Worker port (task 11.1), and the Functions port (task 10.3). Do not hand-edit; regenerate with GEN_DERIVATION_PARITY=1 go test ./agent-go -run TestGenerateDerivationParityFixture.
